en.title: Gary Oldman Believes New James Bond Has Been Chosen
en.summary: Veteran actor Gary Oldman has dropped a significant hint regarding the next James Bond actor, suggesting a decision has been made. He's publicly backing his 'Slow Horses' co-star, Jack Lowden, for the iconic role.
en.body:
The search for the next **James Bond** has been one of the most closely guarded secrets in Hollywood for years, but veteran actor **Gary Oldman** might have just let a crucial detail slip. Speaking in a recent interview, Oldman revealed his belief that the producers have already made their selection for the iconic 007 role, although an official announcement is yet to come.

Oldman, who stars alongside **Jack Lowden** in the Apple TV+ series **Slow Horses**, didn't hold back in expressing his support for the young Scottish actor. He stated that he has his "fingers crossed" for Lowden to be the one to inherit the mantle of the suave secret agent. The rumor mill has been churning for some time, with Lowden frequently cited as a strong contender, and Oldman's endorsement only amplifies that buzz. He noted that Lowden was "in the mix" for the role, suggesting a serious consideration by the casting directors.

## The Bond Contenders Emerge

While **Gary Oldman** is confident a choice has been made, the specifics of the casting process remain under wraps. Producers have indicated that the official reveal could happen before the end of 2026, leaving ample time for speculation and anticipation to build. The role of **James Bond** is one of immense pressure and prestige, and the selection process is notoriously thorough. Oldman's comments, however, suggest that the intensive auditions and deliberations have reached a conclusion behind the scenes at Amazon MGM Studios.

> "They have made their choice, but they have not announced it yet." — **Gary Oldman**

This insider perspective from Oldman is particularly noteworthy given his close working relationship with Lowden on **Slow Horses**, where both actors have garnered significant critical acclaim. Oldman’s backing, therefore, carries considerable weight, providing a potential endorsement from someone who has witnessed Lowden’s talent firsthand in high-stakes dramatic performances. The anticipation for the next **James Bond** film, slated for a 2026 release, is already palpable, and this latest development only intensifies the excitement.

## Why This Matters to Fans

For the global fanbase of **James Bond**, the identity of the next 007 is a topic of passionate debate and fervent hope. Each new actor brings a fresh interpretation to the legendary spy, and the choice significantly shapes the direction of the franchise. **Jack Lowden** has consistently been a fan favorite in online discussions, praised for his versatility and intensity in projects like **Slow Horses** and **Dunkirk**. Oldman’s statement validates these fan sentiments and suggests that the producers might be leaning towards an actor who can deliver a nuanced and compelling performance, potentially steering the franchise in an exciting new direction. The knowledge that a decision is imminent, even if unannounced, provides a focal point for this ongoing conversation.

## What's Next

Fans eagerly await the official confirmation from Amazon MGM Studios regarding the next **James Bond**. While **Gary Oldman** believes the choice has been made, the exact timing of the announcement remains to be seen, with the end of 2026 being the rumored window. Until then, the speculation surrounding **Jack Lowden** and other potential candidates will undoubtedly continue.

content_raw: "They have made their choice, but they have not announced it yet," Oldman says of the upcoming casting for Amazon MGM Studios' new Bond film.
